method: Two separate normal CLI runs using the restored validated AOT binary, each128 output tokens and --stats/--check-logits. Text config with serve removed, max-new128 and fixed2137 cache slots. Context512,workers5,adapt64,spec4/minp0.9,XMXexact8/PACK0. No build, GPU test or other benchmark concurrently. CLI execution and fixed slots differ from persistent auto-cache serving; do not treat these timings as another serving pair.
single_token_bound: Let D be distinct CPU expert jobs and R the summed token applications. Each job with at least2 tokens contributes at least1 to R-D. Hence the single-token fraction is at least1-(R-D)/D=2-R/D. Values use rounded aggregate counters and describe job counts, not time or byte fractions.
interpretation: At least about80% of writing and73% of coding CPU expert jobs serve one token. The preceding multi-token IQ3_S optimization covers only a subset of jobs in10 of48 layers. Prioritize single-token native CPU kernels and the dominant IQ2_S/IQ3_XXS formats; retain upstream CPU/GPU assignment.
